name: top_edelstein_unique_fixed_point
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) : ∃! p : X, f p = p
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y), ∃! p : X, f p = p
informal: Edelstein: a strictly distance-decreasing self-map of a nonempty compact metric space has exactly one fixed point — f is 1-Lipschitz hence continuous, x ↦ dist x (f x) attains its minimum at some p; if f p ≠ p then dist (f p) (f (f p)) < dist p (f p) contradicts minimality; uniqueness is immediate from strictness.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) → ∃! p, f p = p
